newsitem.title: UK: Menzies tumbles after profit and sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Menzies tumbles after profit and sales fall.

text.p: Shares in John Menzies Plc tumbled on Thursday after the British magazine to music retailer announced a fall in Christmas sales and half year profits and warned that full year profits would not make up the shortfall.
By the open of trade at 0830 GMT, Menzies shares had been marked down 80p at 465.

Menzies said Christmas sales were "just below" last year and pre-tax profits for the six months to November 2 were 2.6 million stg, down from 3.8 million a year ago. "This Christmas sales performance, taken together with the shortfall in first half profits, will not be made up on the remainder of the year," it said in a statement.
Shares in fellow retailer W.H. Smith also suffered, dropping 15-1/2p to 423.
